apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Metal 4 native SDR/PQ/HLG conversion and HDR-safe compute sharpening, with Apple color transforms prepared at setup. Generated pixel buffers feed Metal 4 directly where supported. Display deadlines prioritize real video and preserve interpolation history. Retains working desktop native touch, strict 4:4:4 HDR, hardware decode, MetalFX quality/presets, PiP, pointer/finger input and catalogs. FG remains subject to Apple processor format/resolution limits; no silent color downgrade. 206 tests passed, zero failures, one hardware skip; actual Mac GPU checks passed. Unsigned experimental build.
